source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: LiveView supports one listener. The current adapter registers itself in its constructor and clears only itself when detached from a tree, then drops its view and row caches. ClearListener refuses to remove a different current listener. Preserve that identity check when cleanup may occur after replacement. It protects ownership; it does not permit multiple simultaneous listeners. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Pair LiveView listener attachment with identity-aware cleanup
